embarko.description: Official Embarko MCP server (mcp.embarko.ai): a shared workspace to publish, use and improve anything built with AI. Tools: deploy_app (deploy or update an app from its files), read_app (status, logs, deployments, env vars, domains, analytics), update_app (set env vars, add and verify a custom domain, roll back) and app_danger_zone (delete an env var or domain, rename or delete an app). Requires an Embarko account and uses OAuth: after installing, run /mcp in Claude Code to sign in. It has write access: it can deploy, change and delete apps, env vars and domains in your Embarko account.
